story.soThat: I can understand content performance without violating reader privacy

tasks.task: Add `umami` block (`website_id` + `script_url`) to config/_default/params.yaml. Replace placeholder website_id with the real Umami Cloud UUID generated in Phase 0 Task 1.1.
Inject the Umami `` snippet just before `` in layouts/_partials/_base/head.html, gated by `{{- if hugo.IsProduction }}` (separate block from the existing line-21 style-minify gate).

Optional: wrap snippet in `{{- with site.Params.umami.website_id }}…{{- end }}` defensive guard so a missing/empty website_id skips emission instead of producing a malformed `data-website-id=""`. Document the choice in completion notes.

CSP regression check: re-confirm `csp.scriptsrc` and `csp.connectsrc` in config/_default/params.yaml still contain `https://cloud.umami.is`. Build once and grep `public/index.html` for the rendered CSP `` tag. (See constraint C-CSP-PROD-OVERRIDE — production/params.yaml may regress this.)

Production build smoke test: `hugo --quiet --environment production --minify` exits 0; rendered HTML contains `cloud.umami.is/script.js` exactly once per page; `hugo server` (default development env) does NOT contain it.
Out-of-scope handoff: do NOT edit content/pages/datenschutz.md (Story 2.5 owns it). Optionally add a TODO comment in the new umami block referencing Story 2.5.

Manual end-to-end smoke (post-deploy): DevTools Network → 200 on cloud.umami.is/script.js; Cookies → zero on both origins; Console → zero errors / CSP violations across home, article, log, taxonomy pages; Umami Cloud dashboard shows pageviews within ~30s.

Documentation: inline comment in head.html linking back to this story; either short note in docs/3-implementation/phase-0-task-breakdown.md "Phase 1A Stories Complete" or rely on commit message + story file.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion:
Umami `` tag rendered into `
` for every page. Implementation lives in layouts/_partials/_base/head.html (project convention; baseof.html line 3 includes the head partial — equivalent to "added to baseof.html `
`" in epics wording).
Umami website_id and script_url configured in config/_default/params.yaml under a top-level `umami:` block (script_url defaults to `https://cloud.umami.is/script.js`).
Script tag carries both `async` and `defer` attributes (does not block render).
Zero tracking cookies set by the script — verified post-deploy via DevTools → Application → Cookies on article-time.de and on cloud.umami.is. (Cookieless is Umami Cloud's default.)
Pageviews appear in the Umami Cloud dashboard within ~30s of a live visit.
Script loads ONLY in production. `{{ if hugo.IsProduction }}…{{ end }}` gate. `hugo server` source has no `cloud.umami.is/script.js`; `hugo --environment production` output does.

CSP regression check: `csp.scriptsrc` and `csp.connectsrc` still include `https://cloud.umami.is` after the change. Phase 0 Task 4.0 already added them to config/_default/params.yaml lines 25, 29. (See constraint C-CSP-PROD-OVERRIDE.)
No JavaScript console errors / CSP violations / 4xx on the script asset across home, one article, one log, one taxonomy page in production DevTools.

No regression to other head emit. Existing CSS bundle, JS bundle (jquery+gdpr → bundle.js), preload links, favicon links, SEO partial output, and RSS link tag are byte-equivalent before/after for both prod and dev. Diff a representative built page; only the new `` block should differ in production.
`hugo --environment production --minify` exits 0 with no template-execution errors, no missing-variable warnings, no unresolved partial references.

doc.title: Epics Breakdown
doc.snippet: Original 6 ACs verbatim. Story belongs to Epic 2 (Engagement Infrastructure, FR-008/009/010/011/012/013/047/048/049). Effort: 0.5 days. Prereqs: Phase 0 (Umami API key generated, secret added).

doc.title: Technical Architecture Notes
doc.section: 3. Umami Cloud Integration (lines 75–98) — canonical script + params spec
doc.snippet:
Defines the exact `` tag and the `umami: { website_id, script_url }` params.yaml block. Epics AC #1 references baseof.html `
`; project convention places head content in head.html partial.

doc.title: Technical Architecture (PRD)
doc.section: Technology Stack: Engagement = Umami Cloud Hobby (lines 56–67); Configuration block (lines 145–166)
doc.snippet: Tech stack: Hugo 0.147 Extended, Bulma 1.0.4, Node 20, Umami Cloud Hobby (FREE), GitHub Pages. Configuration shows `umami: { website_id, script_url }` and `digital_garden: { grace_period_days, pinned_limit, enable_hearts, enable_webmentions }` blocks.

doc.title: Core Features (PRD)
doc.snippet: Umami Cloud Hobby (FREE), API access, heart button calls `umami.track('heart', { article: permalink })`, daily fetch script reads stats via Bearer-auth API. This story only loads the script; first `umami.track` consumer is Story 2.2.

doc.title: Functional Requirements
doc.section: FR-047 Zero Tracking Cookies (lines 330–333), FR-049 Anonymous Analytics (lines 342–346)
doc.snippet: FR-047: site functions without any tracking cookies; cookie audit shows zero. FR-049: analytics track pageviews + events without personal identification; no user IDs or PII.

doc.title: Final Decisions (locked)
doc.section: Question 6: Umami Analytics Hosting (lines 159–174); Question 1: Cookieless approach
doc.snippet: Locked: Umami Cloud Hobby (FREE forever), 100K events/month, API access confirmed. params.yaml shape `umami: { website_id, script_url }` (lines 483–485).

doc.title: Integration Architecture
doc.section: External Services Inventory (lines 192–195); Critical Agent Rules (lines 762–771)
doc.snippet: Umami Cloud as external service (Bearer token, FREE Hobby). Agent rules: NEVER use jQuery for new features; NEVER commit data/*.json to main; ALWAYS use `| default`; pin Hugo version in GitHub Actions. (Note: arch says pin 0.152.2; current daily-rebuild.yml pins 0.161.1 — drift, see C-HUGO-VERSION-DRIFT.)

constraints.constraint: Script MUST be gated on `{{- if hugo.IsProduction }}` (separate block from the style-minify gate at head.html line 21). `hugo server` MUST NOT emit it. `hugo --environment production` MUST emit it. (AC #6)

config/production/params.yaml currently redefines `csp.scriptsrc` and `csp.connectsrc` WITHOUT `https://cloud.umami.is` — Hugo merges environment overrides on top of `_default`, and lists at the same key REPLACE rather than concatenate. Daily-rebuild.yml builds with `--environment production` (line 122), so the production override IS applied to the live site. Two acceptable resolutions: (a) preferred — add `https://cloud.umami.is` to BOTH `csp.scriptsrc` and `csp.connectsrc` in config/production/params.yaml as part of this story (one-line additions; matches what Phase 0 Task 4.0 intended); or (b) escalate to SM and open a separate Phase 0 cleanup ticket. If unresolved, Umami WILL be CSP-blocked in production despite AC #1 appearing to pass build-time checks — symptom: console error "Refused to load the script… Content Security Policy directive: script-src 'self'…" plus zero pageviews in the Umami dashboard. AC #7 (CSP regression) and AC #8 (no console errors) will catch this only during post-deploy DevTools verification — not earlier. Suggested action: fix in this story, add a one-line note in completion notes.

For reference, the current production override (config/production/params.yaml lines 1-10) carries stale entries (`'unsafe-inline'`, `'unsafe-eval'`, `https://api.bloggify.net`, `https://unpkg.com`) that the modern Phase-0 `_default` CSP has eliminated. Do NOT scope-creep into a full prod-CSP cleanup — scope of this story is Umami only. If fixing per C-CSP-PROD-OVERRIDE, add the two entries (`https://cloud.umami.is` to scriptsrc + connectsrc) and leave the rest untouched. Flag the broader cleanup in completion notes.
No new npm dependencies. Umami Cloud script tag is the official integration; do NOT add `umami-cli`, `umami-tracker`, or any wrapper.
Do NOT modify CSP for any other purpose during this story. Phase 0 Task 4.0 already added `cloud.umami.is` to the `_default` allow-list. AC #7 is a regression check, not a change.

Do NOT edit content/pages/datenschutz.md. Story 2.5 (Privacy Policy Page) explicitly owns the Umami / hearts / webmentions section. If implementing 2.1 before 2.5, optionally add a TODO comment in the new umami params block referencing Story 2.5.
Hugo v0.146+ flat layouts convention — do NOT create `layouts/_default/baseof.html` or `layouts/_default/head.html`. Files are at `layouts/baseof.html` and `layouts/_partials/_base/head.html`.
Project convention for non-critical scripts is `` (see baseof.html line 34 for footerBundle.js). Umami matches.
Project rule: no new jQuery code. Not directly relevant to this story (which adds zero JS), but reinforces "no wrapper libraries".

`website_id` (Umami Cloud UUID) is PUBLIC and rendered into every HTML page's `data-website-id` attribute — safe to commit to params.yaml. The `UMAMI_API_KEY` GitHub Secret is SEPARATE, server-side-only, used by Story 3.1's daily fetch — DO NOT commit it to params.yaml.

.github/workflows/daily-rebuild.yml line 50 pins Hugo `0.161.1`; integration architecture (digital-garden-integration-architecture.md line 770) recommends pinning `0.152.2`. Drift exists. Out of scope here, but worth a follow-up doc/CI ticket. Either pin satisfies this story; the snippet does not depend on a Hugo version newer than 0.115 (config/production/config.yaml `module.hugoVersion.min`).
Use Hugo whitespace controls (`{{- ... -}}`) on the surrounding template lines for clean diff and clean rendered HTML. Acceptable to add a blank line above/below the snippet for readability.
Optional `{{- with site.Params.umami.website_id }}…{{- end }}` defensive guard is acceptable; either form (with or without) satisfies AC #1, #2, #10. Document the choice in completion notes.

Existing head emit (CSS bundle, jquery+gdpr `bundle.js`, preload links, favicon links, SEO partial output, RSS link tag) MUST remain byte-equivalent before/after the change. Diff `public/articles//index.html` pre and post; only the new `` block should differ in production. (AC #9)

tests.standards: Lightweight test strategy matching the 0.5-day scope. Per docs/2-solutioning/test-design-system.md and the test-layering precedent established by Story 1.1 (tests/build/ via node:test, tests/e2e/ via Playwright, optional axe-core for a11y), Umami integration is INVISIBLE to readers — no a11y surface, no UI behavior, no Playwright e2e. Primary verification is manual DevTools smoke (Network/Cookies/Console) plus the Umami Cloud dashboard. Optional: one ~10-line node:test build assertion if Story 1.1's tests/build/build-smoke.test.mjs has landed by implementation time. Do NOT block on Story 1.1; manual smoke is sufficient for this scope. ALWAYS use `| default` when accessing data files (project rule, not directly applicable to this story but worth honouring if templates touch site.Data).
